summary: Leaf delivers one cohesive behavior: each registered ST-03 major creature receives a section 58 vocabulary sound profile (clicks, sub-bass, scraping, resonant harmonics - not all roaring) plus per-band pre-visibility cue lead times, and AudioSystem emits the cue so the creature is audible well before its final visual range. It changes only the audio system - a new pure profile-data module on the AUDIO_STOPS seam in src/util/audio.ts and cue emission in AudioSystem - verified against source (AUDIO_STOPS/distanceGain/worldPan owned by the audio domain; TriggerState.audioCues and the playAudio action present in src/world/triggers.ts), a strict subset of the parent's subsystems; the ST-03 roster and src/world/ are read, not changed. It retains AC-art-sound verbatim, and the union of WI-06e-a/b/c covers the parent's single criterion with WI-06e-c as the named final proof owner (verified). Dependencies on band passes WI-06a/b/c (final visibility and attenuation the lead times are tuned against) are correct and inherited; it is parallel to WI-06e-a with no ancestor or descendant dependency. Evidence is focused: a Node profile-data test (vocabulary tag + per-band lead time + cue range staying ahead of final band visibility), a browser major-creature audible-before-visible encounter check, and the section 34 node-count budget; the handoff names concrete files and symbols. No hidden scope: cues read existing encounter/trigger state and add no creature behavior, and any missing state goes to a defect report rather than new rules. Scope inventory accurate; boundaries non-contradictory. Accepted.
